description.en: Copy another player’s starting role; its ability and copied identity follow the Doppelgänger card.
description.zh: 复制另一位玩家的起始身份，执行相应能力。

description.en: Recognize fellow wolves. A lone awake wolf may inspect one center card.
description.zh: 确认狼队友；独自醒来的狼人可以查看一张中央牌。

description.en: Learn who the original wolves are, without revealing yourself to them.
description.zh: 得知起始狼人是谁，狼人不知道你的身份。

description.en: Recognize the other Mason. Include both Mason cards.
description.zh: 确认另一位共济会成员，配置必须包含两张。

description.en: Inspect another player’s card or two center cards.
description.zh: 查看一位其他玩家的牌，或两张中央牌。

description.en: Optionally exchange your card with another player and inspect your new card.
description.zh: 可与另一位玩家交换身份，然后查看自己的新牌。

description.en: Optionally exchange two other players’ cards without looking.
description.zh: 可交换两位其他玩家的牌，但不能查看。

description.en: Exchange your card with a center card without looking at your new card.
description.zh: 必须与一张中央牌交换，不得查看新牌。

description.en: Inspect your own card near the end of the night.
description.zh: 夜晚接近结束时查看自己的当前身份。

description.en: No night action. Help the village find a final wolf.
description.zh: 没有夜间行动，帮助村庄找出最终的狼人。

description.en: Win if you die. Your death prevents the wolves from winning.
description.zh: 自己死亡即获胜，并阻止狼人阵营获胜。

description.en: If you die, the player you voted for also dies.
description.zh: 如果自己死亡，自己投票指向的玩家也死亡。

description.en: Optionally shield another player’s card from viewing, movement and artifacts.
description.zh: 可保护另一位玩家的牌，防止查看、移动及放置神器。

description.en: Recognize wolves, then exchange the extra center wolf with a non-pack player.
description.zh: 确认狼队友后，将额外中央狼人牌与非狼队友交换。

description.en: Recognize wolves, then optionally inspect another player’s card.
description.zh: 确认狼队友后，可查看另一位玩家的牌。

description.en: Optionally inspect one center card.
description.zh: 可查看一张中央牌。

description.en: Inspect up to two other cards sequentially; seeing a wolf or Tanner transforms you and ends the action.
description.zh: 依次查看最多两位其他玩家；看到狼人或皮匠则变为该身份并停止。

description.en: Optionally view one center card, then you must exchange it with any player’s card.
description.zh: 可先查看一张中央牌，查看后必须与任意玩家的牌交换。

description.en: Optionally rotate every movable card except your own left or right.
description.zh: 可将除自己外所有未受保护的玩家牌顺时针或逆时针移动一位。

description.en: Optionally reveal another card publicly unless it is a wolf or Tanner.
description.zh: 可公开另一位玩家的牌，但狼人或皮匠牌须重新盖回。

description.en: Optionally give one random artifact to an unshielded player.
description.zh: 可给未受保护的玩家一件随机神器。

description.en: Your ballot protects the chosen player instead of adding a vote.
description.zh: 你的投票不计票数，而是保护所指玩家免于被杀。

description.en: The other wolves see you, but you do not see them or wake at night.
description.zh: 其他狼人能认出你，但你不会醒来或得知狼队友。

description.en: Inspect a center card and take its role, acting when that role is called.
description.zh: 查看一张中央牌并成为该身份，在对应环节行动。

description.en: Recognize vampires and together give a non-vampire the Vampire mark.
description.zh: 确认吸血鬼伙伴，共同给予一名非吸血鬼玩家吸血鬼标记。

description.en: Act with vampires. Another final vampire voting for you protects you from the ballot.
description.zh: 与吸血鬼共同行动；最终吸血鬼投票指向你时保护你。

description.en: Act with vampires, then give Fear to another non-vampire to block their night ability.
description.zh: 与吸血鬼共同行动后，给予另一名非吸血鬼恐惧标记，封锁夜间能力。

description.en: Learn vampires and the infected player; place the Bat mark on yourself.
description.zh: 得知吸血鬼及感染对象，给自己蝙蝠标记。

description.en: Mark an adjacent player Diseased. Anyone voting for the Diseased role or mark cannot win.
description.zh: 给相邻玩家疾病标记；投票给病人身份或疾病标记的人无法获胜。

description.en: Give up to two Love marks. Final Love holders share death but keep their teams.
description.zh: 可给予最多两枚爱情标记；最终恋人同生共死但保留阵营。

description.en: Optionally give a Traitor mark: its holder needs another teammate to die.
description.zh: 可给予叛徒标记，持有者需要另一位队友死亡才能获胜。

description.en: Clear your own mark and optionally another player’s mark.
description.zh: 清除自己的标记，并可清除另一位玩家的标记。

description.en: Mark any player; win if a final Assassin-mark holder dies.
description.zh: 标记任意玩家；最终持有刺客标记的人死亡即可获胜。

description.en: Learn the Assassin and win if they die; if absent, place your own Assassin mark.
description.zh: 认出刺客，刺客死亡则获胜；若刺客不在玩家中则自己设置刺客标记。

description.en: Inspect another player’s card and/or a different player’s mark.
description.zh: 可查看一位其他玩家的牌，和／或另一位不同玩家的标记。

description.en: Optionally exchange your mark with another player and inspect your new mark.
description.zh: 可与另一位玩家交换标记并查看自己的新标记。

description.en: Optionally exchange any two player cards OR marks, including your own.
description.zh: 可交换任意两位玩家的身份牌或标记，可包含自己。
